en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Is’haq Bin Ammar who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> judged regarding the man who was struck upon his lower part, so he was no longer able to withhold his faeces nor his urine, that with regards to that is the complete wergild’.
